notes.about: Malayalam as the engine has always read it. These rules were code (engine/core/src/script/mlym.rs, malayalam.rs and the joins in suffix.rs) until they became this file; the engine also carries a copy for a mlym pack that has no lang file. ml.fst is built by `lexbuild` (data/build-lexicons.sh) with these same rules, not by lexbuild-native, so the builder's keys (firstLetter, signs, maxWords, minCount) are not here.
notes.block: Malayalam, U+0D00-U+0D7F. Text is split into words at anything outside the block.
notes.notLetter: The digits ൦-൯, the fraction and number signs and the date mark (U+0D64-U+0D79) stay inside a run when text is split, as Malayalam text always has been, but a word is not made of them: letters are U+0D00-U+0D63 and the chillus U+0D7A-U+0D7F.
notes.bases: The consonants ക-ഺ. A vowel sign attaches to one; the chillus never take a sign.
notes.replace: None here. The normal form is the engine's own (normalize.rs): NFC, ’ to ', a consonant + virama + ZWJ that has an atomic chillu becomes that chillu (ന്‍ to ൻ), and a ZWJ or ZWNJ is kept only between a virama and a Malayalam letter.
notes.looseSigns: The vowel signs ാ ി ീ ു ൂ ൃ െ േ ൈ ൊ ോ. Loose spelling inserts one between consonants (ആവിശ്യം for ആവശ്യം), so the spelling without a medial sign is tried too. A final sign is inflection and is kept.
notes.finalPairs: A word ending in a consonant + ു is also written with ് (samvruthokaram): ഇന്നു and ഇന്ന്. Older text has ു where chat writes ്.
notes.suffixJoins: How a stem and a suffix of suffixes.tsv fuse. vowelSigns: the sign each independent vowel becomes on a consonant (അ is the consonant's own vowel). nasal: a final ം becomes മ before a vowel suffix (സുഖം + ആണോ is സുഖമാണോ), doesn't take a case ending, and is replaced by an oblique one (മരം + ത്തിൽ is മരത്തിൽ). finalForms: a chillu becomes its consonant before a vowel (അവൻ + ഓട് is അവനോട്). elide: a final ് or ു gives way to the suffix's vowel (കഴിച്ചു + ഓ is കഴിച്ചോ). glides: വ after u and o sounds (പൂ + ഇൽ is പൂവിൽ), യ after the other vowels and, as inherentGlide, after a bare consonant's own a (അമ്മ + ഓട് is അമ്മയോട്). consonantAfter: ർ and ൾ take a suffix that starts with a consonant (അവൾ + ക്ക് is അവൾക്ക്), as stems ending in a vowel do; ൻ doesn't.
